record.title: DfCM frontier current
record.body: R53 changed the reachable frontier from raw transitive consumer propagation to causally qualified returned-evidence propagation. Current strongest next subjects: (1) project real returned receipts from ggen#670 and ex4pm#32 into the causal graph with exact independent evidence roots; (2) execute the consumer contract in a freshly resolved chatgpt-cloud-elixir subject and return its receipt; (3) manufacture counterfactual witness collection so temporal succession can be falsified; (4) measure causal fanout and realized dependency-relief conversion across independently qualified consumers; (5) reconcile or supersede stale PR263 only after proving its 500-549 transitive sensor capital is contained or separately needed. Preserve R45/R45B and independent consumer alternatives. Weakest multiplier is causally-qualified consumer fanout, not producer-local sensor count.
